This name carries the weight of a rich history, as well as the resilience, resourcefulness, and self-sufficiency that these communities have long embodied.

Thus, the name can serve as a reminder of the importance of staying grounded, maintaining a deep connection to one's faith and the natural world, and persevering in the face of adversity.
